title: Hezekiah Shows God the Letter
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who pauses and ponders before she moves, and tonight Hezekiah stops to pray before he does anything about the scary letter: Wren loses her library book, sits on the stairs, and tells Heavenly Father all about it before she starts searching.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she stops and thinks before she acts, and Hezekiah stopped to pray before he did anything. In Wren’s world today: her library book is missing, and it is due tomorrow. Wren does not cry or run around the house. She sits on the stairs and tells Heavenly Father all about it. Then she remembers the porch swing, and there it is. Just like Hezekiah spreading the letter before the Lord, Wren learned that a worry gets smaller when you hand it to Heavenly Father.
